local function buildTemple(city)
 local holy=assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE).Index
 local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_TEMPLE).Index
 if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(temple) then
  local site,empty
  for dir=0,5 do
   local q=Map.GetAdjacentPlot(city:GetX(),city:GetY(),dir)
   if q and q:GetOwner()==city:GetOwner() then
    if q:GetDistrictType()==holy then site=q;break end
    if not empty and q:GetDistrictType()==-1 and q:GetImprovementType()==-1 and not q:IsCity() and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain() and not q:IsImpassable() and not q:IsNaturalWonder() then empty=q end
   end
  end
  if not site then site=assert(empty,'no legal owned Holy Site fixture plot');city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteDistrict(holy,site:GetIndex(),100) end
  local shrine=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE).Index
  if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(shrine) then city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(shrine,site:GetIndex(),100) end
  city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(temple,site:GetIndex(),100)
 end
 assert(city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(temple),'official temple fixture absent')
 return temple
end

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()];local cap=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity();local b=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_ABSORPTION_CACHE'];buildTemple(cap);p:AttachModifierByID('GOODY_CULTURE_GRANT_ONE_RELIC');local target;for _,other in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if other:GetID()~=p:GetID() then target=other:GetID();break end end;assert(target,'native deal target missing');local targetCity=assert(Players[target]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(),'AI capital missing');local targetBuilding=buildTemple(targetCity);Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_SLOT',{Owner=target,City=targetCity:GetID(),X=targetCity:GetX(),Y=targetCity:GetY(),Building=targetBuilding,Slot=0});local diplomacy=p:GetDiplomacy();if not diplomacy:HasMet(target) then diplomacy:SetHasMet(target) end;Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_OWNER',p:GetID());Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_TARGET',target);return 'granted native relic in existing city and met deal target'

function ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeDealLocations(index)
 local found={}
 local owners=PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
 local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
 local hasFree=false;for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if owner==free then hasFree=true end end
 if free and free>=0 and not hasFree then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
  for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do
   local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
   for b in GameInfo.Buildings() do
    if buildings:HasBuilding(b.Index) then
     for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(b.Index)-1 do
      if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(b.Index,slot)==index then found[#found+1]={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=b.Index,Slot=slot} end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return found
end

local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_TARGET'))
local locations=ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeDealLocations(d.Work.Index)

assert(#locations==1,'deal index must remain in exactly one physical slot')
local found=locations[1]
if found.Owner~=target then
 assert(found.Owner==d.Owner and found.City==d.Work.City and found.X==d.Work.X and found.Y==d.Work.Y and found.Building==d.Work.Building and found.Slot==d.Work.Slot and sourceWork==d.Work.Index,'deal moved native index to an unexpected location')
 return false
end
assert(sourceWork==-1,'deal retained the source work')
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(found.X,found.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==target and city:GetID()==found.City)
assert(city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(found.Building,found.Slot)==d.Work.Index,'target exact physical index changed')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_DESTINATION] owner='..target..' city='..found.City..' building='..found.Building..' slot='..found.Slot..' index='..d.Work.Index)
return true
